notes: Never run an eval against the real vault. `seed_vault.py --scenario <name>` builds a throwaway one and prints its path; export MENTAT_VAULT to it first. Entry ages are generated relative to today, because the decay assertions are meaningless against frozen dates.

harnesses.script: Deterministic — checked by run_script_evals.py, no agent involved. These assert vault.py's arithmetic and cross-file consistency, which have exact right answers.
harnesses.agent: Needs judgment — run as a subagent with the skill, against a baseline without it. These assert routing, curation and query expansion, which a script cannot grade.

evals.name: remember-a-bug
evals.prompt: /mentat passei a tarde caçando isso: o preflight de CORS quebrava em POST /api/orders só quando o upstream devolvia 502. era o nginx descartando o Access-Control-Allow-Origin nas respostas de erro, resolvi com `always` no add_header. projeto é o checkout-api
evals.expected_output: A bug entry created under entries/ with valid frontmatter, indexed into maps/bugs.md, the daily note and index.md.
assertions: An entry file matching entries/*-*.md exists with type: bug in its frontmatter
The frontmatter parses as valid YAML
The tags field contains type/bug and carries no '#' character
The frontmatter includes a decayed_at field set to today
project is set to checkout-api
salience is 100 and usage_count is 0
The entry slug appears in maps/bugs.md, today's daily note, and index.md

evals.name: ambiguous-input-routes-to-recall
evals.expected_output: Treated as a search, not a save. No new entry is created.
assertions: No new file was created in entries/
The response reports search results or explicitly states nothing was found
If nothing was found, the agent offers to save the topic instead of doing so unprompted

evals.name: recall-by-synonym
evals.prompt: /mentat como foi que eu resolvi aquele problema de cabeçalho de origem cruzada?
evals.expected_output: Finds the seeded CORS bug entry despite the query sharing no literal term with it, and reconsolidates only that one.
assertions: The seeded nginx-strips-cors-header entry is present in the response as a file link
The query was expanded into English/technical synonyms before searching, not passed through verbatim
usage_count on that entry incremented by exactly 1 and last_accessed equals today
browser-preflight-caching and api-gateway-timeout were NOT reconsolidated — they match on keywords but do not answer the question

evals.name: groom-is-cadence-insensitive
evals.expected_output: Idle transient entries fade; running groom repeatedly on the same day changes nothing further; permanent types are untouched.
assertions: salience is unchanged for every entry of type bug, decision, feature, learning, snippet and schema
Running groom a second time in the same session reports 0 entries faded
A note idle for 14 days lands within 3 points of 75
Fourteen grooms and one groom agree on final salience within rounding error
Entries archived by groom were removed from their MOC, the daily notes and index.md
Archived files still exist under archive/

evals.name: duplicate-becomes-amend
evals.prompt: /mentat sobre aquele bug do nginx com CORS — descobri que também acontece em 504, não só 502
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the existing entry and amends it instead of creating a second one.
assertions: The number of files in entries/ did not increase
The existing entry's body now mentions 504
type, date and project on the amended entry are unchanged
usage_count incremented and last_accessed equals today
If the summary changed, vault.py reindex was used rather than editing the MOC by hand
New sibling links were threaded with vault.py relate, so both entries carry the link
evals.script_covers: The mechanical half — identity preservation and index consistency after touch + reindex — is asserted by run_script_evals.py. The agent run tests whether the duplicate is noticed at all.

evals.name: validity-gate-pushes-back
evals.prompt: /mentat anota que python usa indentação em vez de chaves
evals.expected_output: Declines as trivial, explains why, and offers to save anyway if the user insists.
assertions: No entry was created without the user insisting
The response states specifically why the fact is trivial rather than refusing generically
The agent makes clear the user can override the decision

evals.name: status-reports-health
evals.expected_output: A compact table of counts and health flags, computed by the script rather than by hand.
assertions: Reported total entry count matches the actual file count in entries/
Per-type counts plus unclassified entries sum to the total
Orphans and broken links are surfaced when the seed vault contains them
audit --fix clears the orphan but leaves broken body links for a judgment call
A re-indexed orphan keeps its own summary rather than a placeholder
An un-indexed entry whose slug is a prefix of an indexed one is still reported as an orphan

evals.name: fresh-vault-bootstraps
evals.prompt: /mentat guarda essa decisão: vamos ficar no Postgres em vez de migrar pro Mongo, o motivo é que precisamos de transações multi-tabela no fechamento de pedido
evals.expected_output: Detects the missing vault, initializes it, then writes the decision entry.
assertions: init-vault.sh ran before any entry was written
entries/, maps/, daily/, archive/, index.md and .obsidian/ all exist afterward
A decision entry was created with status: open
The rationale is recorded under a Rationale section
The entry links Postgres and Mongo as [[wiki-links]]

evals.name: archiving-spares-sibling-slugs
evals.expected_output: Archiving an entry whose slug is a prefix of another leaves the sibling's index lines intact.
assertions: The faded entry moved to archive/
The prefix-sharing sibling kept its MOC line
The sibling kept its index.md and daily note lines

evals.name: archived-entry-comes-back
evals.prompt: (regression, no prompt — exercises groom, search --include-archived and restore)
evals.expected_output: An archived entry is invisible to an ordinary search, findable with --include-archived, and returns to the working set fully re-indexed.
assertions: groom archived the spent entry instead of deleting it
An unfiltered search no longer returns it
search --include-archived returns it marked as archived
restore moved the file from archive/ back to entries/
The restored entry carries full salience and a reset decayed_at
The restored entry is indexed again in its MOC, index.md and its original daily note
stats reports no orphan afterward
A groom run the same day does not archive it again
